discipline: dungeon-jev — the JEV waveform player (worksheet quilt; verdict cell = superposed distribution over 5 actions; JEV as weight-tuner)
sealedBefore: any model call, any A/B run — the jepa gold standard

definitions.waveTick: a row of class:'wave' in receipts/waveform.jsonl (JEV seated, probabilities over all 5 actions receipted)
definitions.gap: p1 - p2, the top-2 action probabilities of the wave, descending-sorted
definitions.sharp: gap > eps, eps = 0.15 (pre-registered here, before any run)
definitions.flat: gap <= eps — the collapse is free (cheap local tiebreak rule takes over)
definitions.modelNeeded: sharp — per the mission law: flat wave => model not needed (local collapse), sharp wave => the model's pick stands
definitions.danger: the local threat-level cell value (0-3) computed by rules, receipted in the same row
definitions.normalizedEntropy: Shannon entropy of the 5 action probabilities, divided by log2(5), in [0,1]
definitions.seedsJevStrictlyBetter: count of seeds 1-8 where the JEV-weights run scores strictly more than the old-weights run (same engine, same seeds, zero model calls both legs)

claims.claim: JEV-weighted script beats baseline mean score on >=5/8 seeds: after JEV proposes new cell weights from the waveform + score summaries, the script with JEV weights scores strictly better than the script with old weights on at least 5 of seeds 1-8 (fresh runs, zero model calls, identical vendored engine).
claims.refusal: 4 or fewer of 8 seeds strictly better => FAIL: the tuner patch is receipted but is NOT adopted as an improvement of the quilt's player-logic.

claims.claim: <=35% of ticks need the model seat (the wave is flat elsewhere): over all wave ticks, the fraction with sharp waves (gap > eps=0.15) is <= 35%.
claims.refusal: >35% sharp ticks => the wave is rarely flat in this dungeon; the local-collapse takeover thesis fails here (honest finding, receipted either way).

vacuousIf.note: fewer than 6 wave ticks cannot ground a fleet-level claim; VACUOUS, never PASS.

claims.claim: Waveform entropy correlates with tick danger (sharp where threats near): Spearman rho between normalized wave entropy and the local threat-level cell (0-3), over all wave ticks, is <= -0.40.
claims.refusal: rho > -0.40 => the wave does not sharpen where danger rises; P3 FAIL (the measured rho is receipted either way).

vacuousIf.note: a correlation over <=5 points is non-discriminating; VACUOUS, never PASS.
